payload.body: Fixed in PR #7. Member-macro output is invisible to @Observable's expansion, so emitting working observation plumbing from @FrickModel is not reliably possible — chose the document-and-assert route. Corrected the false 'observed' doc on the generated dto; documented the @Observable incompatibility + two supported patterns (replace the model instance — standard Frick store pattern — or hand-declare dto) on both the macro impl and the public macro decl. Added a regression test (packages/swift/Tests/FrickSwiftTests/FrickModelMacroIntegrationTests.swift) pinning that dto is NOT observation-tracked under @Observable. All 7 Swift macro tests green.
